answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a reputation-based Sybil resistance mechanism, where agents are assigned a unique digital identity tied to a scarce resource, such as a specific shade of opal. To establish a new identity, an agent must demonstrate control over a corresponding amount of umber, a costly and difficult-to-fake resource. This creates a haven for honest agents, as attackers attempting to create multiple fake identities would incur significant costs, making it economically infeasible to launch a Sybil attack.
